description: Operator polls jobs assigned to their kernel; status defaults to queued, and the route can filter any status. Requires operate authority for this kernel: its recorded operator identity (the caller that registered it), its proven operator wallet, or the gateway admin authority. Another identity gets 403; no credentials gets 401; an unregistered kernel gets 404 for a non-admin. Operator identity proof for operate is completed by WP-A (DECISIONS items 136 and 138). The pcc-node 0.1.1 daemon does not call it: it takes no jobs.

kernelId.description: Kernel ID to poll jobs for

name: operator_poll_jobs
